# The topology generated by weighted supremum seminorms

Let 𝕜 be a real or complex scalar field and E a normed 𝕜-vector space. Write s(𝕜,E) for the
sequences f : ℕ → E such that pₖ(f) = supₙ (n+1)^k‖fₙ‖ is finite for every k ∈ ℕ. The topology
of s(𝕜,E) is generated by its family (pₖ)ₖ∈ℕ; finite intersections of sets pₖ(f−f₀) < ε give
the seminorm neighborhoods of f₀.
